_key.description: Human genomic element key and mouse genomic element key joined by an underscore.

_from.description: Handle of the mouse genomic element.

_to.description: Handle of the paired human genomic element.

percent_identical_bp.description: Fraction of aligned bases that are identical between the human and mouse elements.

phastCons4way.description: phastCons score of the aligned interval, computed on a 4-way alignment.

phyloP4way.description: phyloP score of the aligned interval, computed on a 4-way alignment.

cov_chromatin_accessibility.description: FUNCODE conservation of variable activity (CO-V) for chromatin accessibility: the weighted Spearman correlation of accessibility across in silico matched human and mouse samples.

cov_chromatin_accessibility_fdr.description: Benjamini–Hochberg FDR for the chromatin-accessibility CO-V p-value.
